intro.title: Last Time...
intro.sub:
Kimi filled her room with art! 🎨
Today Minsu is coming over to play — and something BIG happens with a bike.

scenes.title: Ball Games with Minsu
scenes.caption:
Throw! Catch! Bounce!
The ball flies between two friends.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Let's play ball, Minsu! Here it goes! ⚽

lines.speaker: friend
lines.text: Oops, I missed it! 😅

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Catch the ball with two hands. Throw it up high!

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Wow! You two can catch the ball very well!

scenes.title: The Big Squabble
scenes.caption:
Minsu grabs the ball. Kimi's hand goes up...
STOP. Use words, not hands.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: He hit me first! 😠

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: It's bad to hit others. Hold it even if you want to hit him.

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Don't hit him, talk to him. If you hit him back, you will do the wrong thing, too.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: ...I'm sorry, Minsu. 😔

lines.speaker: friend
lines.text: It's okay. Let's play again! 🤝

scenes.title: Promise You Won't Let Go
scenes.caption:
Training wheels OFF. Helmet ON.
Kimi's shaky first ride on two wheels!

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Let's learn how to ride a bike with two wheels. Make sure you put on your helmet. 🪖

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Can you hold the bike so I won't fall? Promise you won't let go of it!

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Don't be nervous. Grab the handlebars tightly. Step on the pedal hard!

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Don't let go, Mommy! ...Wait, are you still holding?! I'M RIDING! 🚲

scenes.title: Everything Back in Place
scenes.caption:
The playdate is over, and the floor
is a toy ocean. Time to tidy!

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: There are lots of things on the floor. Put the used things back into their place.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Where was this before?

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Put the things where they belong, so you can find them easily.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Ball in the box, helmet on the shelf. All done! ✔️

scenes.title: Pooped!
scenes.caption:
Ball games, a bike ride, big feelings...
one very sleepy champion.

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Mom, I'm tired. I can't even move a finger... 🥱

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: You look exhausted. Why do you look so down? Want to take a nap?

lines.speaker: kimi
lines.text: Just... five... more... Zzz... 😴

lines.speaker: mom
lines.text: Sweet dreams, my little champion. 🏆

ending.title: What a Day, Champion!
ending.sub: To be continued... Next episode: The Sniffly Day! 🩸
